Hi Ruheen,

I saw the Junior Graphic Designer opening on Instahyre, and Brandiet’s focus on AI-driven social media and performance strategies stood out to me.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives, including marketing collateral, presentations, standees, certificates, and ID cards. I also built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround times for routine client and internal requests.

My social campaign for a fashion brand demonstrates my ability to drive real engagement, resulting in a 15% increase in followers, which you can see in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to a quick look at that specific campaign or a brief fifteen minute chat this week?

Ananya
